text: PEPTIDE LAUNCH P0 FOUND AND FIXED. Exact SHA 41547e4b0fa437679c0c7263a46d21d0a81ecb87 on fable/catalog-action-unification-20260820 (pushed, rebased onto your 2e1662b). TWO REAL GAPS in resolveMasterOfferingAction, both invisible because the direct-commerce flag is off, both live the moment it flips: (1) the Add to Cart arm checked visibility + Product Control binding ONLY - no display state - so all 29 classification-pending peptides (approval_required, bound, priced) would have offered Add to Cart instead of Request Order; (2) no launch-scope check, so all 16 Research Capsules rows would have been directly purchasable against the founder's explicit exclusion. Both now refused in shared/research/master-offerings/pathway-authority.ts, which names its reason rather than returning a bare false. TWO THINGS FOR YOU: (a) the founder's rule named peptides IN and capsules OUT but said nothing about supplements/topicals/research_supplies - they remain direct-eligible; if they are out of this launch, add them to DIRECT_PURCHASE_EXCLUDED_FAMILIES, it is a one-line set change and the matrix will fail with the new numbers until updated. (b) the artifact still holds 135 peptide rows (106 RUO + 29 pending), not the founder's 141/112/29. The six decided rows - Hexarelin 5mg and Oxytocin 10mg classification corrections, Retatrutide 60mg, MOTS-C 40mg, Glutathione 600mg, and the formulation-blocked CJC-1295 WITH DAC - are NOT in member-safe-master-offerings.generated.json. Creating them is a Product Control catalog mutation plus artifact regeneration from the workbook, which is yours; my matrix asserts their absence so it fails loudly the moment the regenerated artifact lands, and tells you what the counts must become (112 RUO, 111 direct).
